title: Incongruence-Aware Evaluation of Multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition in Audio Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.40883v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voice-interactive large language models process both what a speaker says and how they say it, yet the two channels do not always agree. We ask whether that disagreement degrades speech emotion recognition. Mapping text and audio into a shared valence-arousal-dominance space, we convert the distance between them into a continuous, threshold-free incongruence score with a two-component Gaussian mixture, and validate the score against human judgement. We evaluate three audiocapable models on acted, conversational and spontaneous speech (eNTERFACE'05, MELD and CMU-MOSEI). With the model held constant across modalities, incongruence raises the odds of error whenever audio is present, in every corpus, after controlling for the ground-truth emotion and for distance in the feature space. translated_title: 音频大语言模型中多模态语音情感识别的不一致性感知评估
translated_abstract: 语音交互大语言模型同时处理说话者所说的内容（文本）以及说话的方式（音频），然而这两个通道并不总是一致的。我们探究这种不一致是否会降低语音情感识别的性能。通过将文本和音频映射到共享的效价-唤醒度-支配度空间中，我们利用双分量高斯混合模型将两者之间的距离转换为一个连续的、无需阈值的不一致性得分，并通过人类判断对该得分进行了验证。我们在表演性、对话性和自发性语音（eNTERFACE'05、MELD 和 CMU-MOSEI 数据集）上评估了三个具备音频能力的模型。在跨模态保持模型不变、并控制了真实情感标签和特征空间距离的情况下，只要音频存在，不一致性在所有语料库中都会增加出错的几率。而在相同特征上训练的监督分类器表现出相反的行为，这表明困难之处在于这些模型如何组合原始证据。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于双分量高斯混合模型、将文本与音频在情感空间中的距离转化为连续无阈值得分的不一致性度量方法，并发现文本与音频情感表达的不一致会在所有语料库中系统性增加音频大语言模型语音情感识别的错误率，而监督分类器则表现出相反的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a continuous, threshold-free incongruence score based on a two-component Gaussian mixture and shows that text-audio emotional incongruence systematically increases speech emotion recognition errors in audio LLMs across all corpora, while supervised classifiers behave in the opposite way.
